verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Cursor's account-wide Privacy Mode, available to free and Pro users and enforceable by team admins, which guarantees Cursor will not train on your data. That is a data-use opt-out, not an explicit opt-out of telemetry or usage tracking, and nothing ties it specifically to Bugbot. missing for 10: an explicit telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control, documentation that Privacy Mode applies to Bugbot reviews, a description of what usage data is still collected when opted out, and independent corroboration.
